properties.name: app.baseurl
properties.description: Baseurl for the application (e.g., http://localhost or https://mydomain.com). This is used for generating the shortened URLs.

properties.name: app.defaultHoursTTL
properties.description: Default Time-To-Live for shortened URLs in hours (0 = infinite)

properties.name: app.cleanup.cron
properties.description: Cleanup job cron expression. Cron-Syntax: 'Seconds Minutes Hours Day-of-Month Month Day-of-Week'. Example: '0 0 3 * * *' equals: daily at 3 AM
